description: Historical Kaspa network metric as aggregated timeseries (max 1000 points). Metrics: hashrate, difficulty, block_rate, mempool_tx_count, peer_count (only until 2026-08-10), daa_score, tip_count, node_hashrate, circulating_supply, pct_mined. Intervals: 5m|1h|1d. from_iso/to_iso are ISO-8601 timestamps. Collected continuously by our own infrastructure (own Kaspa node until 2026-08-10, since then snapshots of the public api.kaspa.org). Informational research data - not investment advice. $0.05
